classification.event_that_restored_ddp: Matrix reboot caused by the single diagnostic firmware installation; WLED/network/sender lifecycle was reinitialized.
classification.historical_root_cause: Persistent pre-restart failure mechanism is not conclusively isolated because no sender counters existed before the reboot. Evidence rules out a persistent downstream/AP/AUX failure during the observed post-restart window; a stale Matrix sender/runtime lifecycle is the leading explanation, not a proven specific code defect.
classification.permanent_firmware_fix: None justified by evidence; diagnostic patch changed telemetry only, and no transport/spec change is indicated.
classification.sender_vs_downstream: Matrix native DDP sender is operating and the Opal/AP/AUX path accepts its output after Matrix restart: all later attempts produced successful sends, and AUX continuously reported live=true, lm=DDP, lip=192.168.77.10.

next: Restore exact R4 once using the explicitly authorized rollback path, verify runtime identity and AUX DDP live, then leave Matrix on R4. No Phase 2 production candidate install or deployment.
